---
title: "Plugin: hook-discord"
description: Posts rich release announcements with contributor recognition and retry handling to Discord via webhook.
---

<!-- This code has been fully generated by an AI. -->

Posts a rich release embed to Discord using an incoming webhook. Supports automatic retries on transient HTTP failures and Discord `429` rate limits, plus optional **New Contributors** and **🏆 Release MVP** shoutouts powered by `SEMREL_CONTRIBUTORS`.

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/hook-discord
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.

### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/hook-discord:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/hook-discord:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/hook-discord/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/hook-discord
    phase: release
    args:
      discord_webhook_url: '${env.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}'
      repository: SemRels/semrel
      first_time_contributors: "true"
      release_mvp: "true"
      max_retries: "3"
      retry_delay: 2s
```

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` | yes (unless dry-run) | `—` | Discord incoming webhook URL. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_REPOSITORY` | no | `—` | Repository name or URL displayed in the Discord embed fields. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_RELEASE_URL` | no | derived | Explicit release URL for the embed title link. Derived from `SEMREL_REPOSITORY_URL` or `SEMREL_PLUGIN_REPOSITORY` when unset. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTORS` | no | `false` | Add a **New Contributors** embed field when contributor metadata is available (alias: `SEMREL_PLUGIN_NEW_CONTRIBUTORS`). |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_RELEASE_MVP` | no | `false` | Add a **🏆 Release MVP** embed field for the contributor with the most commits (alias: `SEMREL_PLUGIN_MVP`). |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_MAX_RETRIES` | no | `3` | Retry count on transient network errors and HTTP `5xx` responses (`429` honours `Retry-After`). |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_RETRY_DELAY` | no | `2s` | Delay between retry attempts. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_CONTRIBUTORS_JSON` | no | `—` | Legacy contributor JSON payload (`SEMREL_CONTRIBUTORS` from semrel core is preferred). |

## Release Context Variables

- `SEMREL_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_TAG_NAME`
- `SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_CHANGELOG`
- `SEMREL_CONTRIBUTORS`
- `SEMREL_REPOSITORY_URL`
- `SEMREL_DRY_RUN`

## Example Embed

When `SEMREL_DRY_RUN=true`, the plugin prints the JSON webhook payload to stdout without sending an HTTP request. On a live release, it posts an embed containing the release title, changelog summary, version, repository, and optional contributor shoutouts.
